name: pyrilamine
uses: Uses ■ temporarily relieves runny nose and alleviates sneezing, itching of the nose or throat, and itchy, watery eyes due to hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies.
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use if the child has ■ a breathing problem such as emphysema or chronic bronchitis ■ glaucoma Stop use and ask a doctor if new symptoms occur
